blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of V207 crouch and sit renders shows both thighs projecting in front of the overskirt, exposing the shorts and leaving the lap uncovered. The lilac hem doubles back behind the knees and pointed panels hang below the seat.

Standing front, three-quarter and side images show angular creases across the front pleats. In prone, the rear panel covers the upper thighs but the front fabric bunches beneath the hips into overlapping folds.
Arms-up render shows a small gray patch at the viewer-right inner upper arm. Its cause is uncertain from the image; sleeve opening or rendering gap is not classified as proven.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
